title: ascend-performance-analysis
summary: Diagnose performance bottlenecks on Ascend NPU systems using CANN profiling data. Maps GPU profiling concepts (nsys, ncu, SOL%, roofline) to their NPU equivalents (msprof, torch_npu.profiler, CSV/JSON outputs, AI Core utilization, HCCL communication analysis). Covers measurement discipline on shared NPU machines and evidence acceptance for automated NPU optimization stages. Use when profiling data is available or a stage report needs its execution and validation evidence checked.
